title: Principal localization of resolution cohomology
statement: Let $f:X\to T$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions], let $F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and let $I$ be any injective resolution of $F$. For $q\in\mathbb N$, let $P=H^q(f_*I)$ denote presheaf homology of the underlying module presheaf complex [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. For every affine open $W\subseteq T$ and $a\in\Gamma(T,W)$, the restriction $P(W)\to P(D(a))$, regarded as a $\Gamma(T,W)$-linear map by restriction of scalars, is module localization at the powers of $a$.

source.place: Tags 09MR and 01E4: tensor-unit specialization and resolution/evaluation comparison.

proof.text: Apply the existing sectionCohomologyPresheaf_isLocalized_away to f, F, I, q, W, hW and a. Its let-bound complex and presheaf reduce to the displayed presheaf, and its explicit restriction-of-scalars module structure is definitionally the structure on the codomain of P.map. Thus its conclusion is exactly the requested IsLocalizedModule.Away assertion, without any transport or additional hypotheses.

lean.statement:
theorem higherImageCohomologyPresheaf_isLocalized
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (I : InjectiveResolution F) (q : ℕ)
    (W : T.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (a : Γ(T, W)) :
    let P := sectionCohomologyPresheaf
      (((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex) q
    IsLocalizedModule.Away a (P.map (homOfLE (T.basicOpen_le a)).op).hom
